_comment: CONFIRMED Cube (mode:9) column geometry — human-calibrated in Malody V on 2026-07-20 via the 00_column_test chart (columns lit ascending). Coordinates are unit-hex positions in SCREEN convention (y DOWN, so negative y is up/top). Calibration: col0=左上(upper-left), col1=左中(left-middle), col2=左下(lower-left), col3=右下(lower-right), col4=右中(right-middle), col5=右上(upper-right). The user's personal habit naming for these six positions (in calibration order) is 1,3,5,6,4,2 — i.e. habit1->col0, habit2->col5, habit3->col1, habit4->col4, habit5->col2, habit6->col3; habit names are REFERENCE ONLY and never override the file column indices 0..5. Left hand group {0,1,2} (x<0); right hand group {3,4,5} (x>0). ring_order is the cyclic perimeter order for 转圈/spin (counterclockwise = calibration order [0,1,2,3,4,5]; clockwise = [0,5,4,3,2,1]).
